duration.from: Proposed countywide moratorium on new data centers, intended by its sponsor (Commissioner Diana Helm) to last until the Oregon Legislature takes up the issue in its 2027 session. The Board of Commissioners voted unanimously on approximately 2026-08-04/08-05 to begin the formal process for a moratorium; Oregon law requires 45 days' notice to the Department of Land Conservation and Development before a public hearing on the proposed moratorium can be held. As of a September 15, 2026 news report, Clackamas County was still described as merely 'considering' a moratorium (alongside Salem, which adopted its own that month); no report of a final Board vote to adopt the moratorium was found as of 2026-09-23.
